name: traffic-torch-live

scripts.build: cp messages/messages.js ./messages.js && cp messages/profile-message.js ./profile-message.js && node generate-posts.cjs && node generate-search-index.cjs && vite build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && find . -maxdepth 1 -not -name 'dist' -not -name '.' -not -name 'node_modules' -not -name 'workers' -not -name 'messages' -not -name 'traffic-torch-auth' -not -name 'cors-proxy-worker' -not -name 'api-worker' -not -name 'auth-worker' -not -name 'torches' -not -name '_backups' -not -name '.cache' -not -name '.config' -not -name '.devcontainer' -not -name '.vscode' -not -name '.wrangler' -not -name '.npm-cache' -not -name 'dist' -exec cp -r {} dist/ \; && rm -rf dist/node_modules dist/.git dist/.gitignore dist/package*.json dist/vite.config.js dist/wrangler.jsonc dist/wrangler.toml dist/.vite dist/.cache dist/.config dist/.devcontainer dist/.vscode dist/.wrangler dist/workers && find dist -name '*.bak*' -delete

description: **Instant 360° SEO + UX Health Scanner**   Fast, fully client-side tool that analyzes any website for SEO health, Performance, UX frustration signals, AI-content probability, E-E-A-T signals, intent alignment, topical authority gaps, predictive rank health, and more — with educational metric explanations, plugin solutions and shareable results.
